name: Hangzhou Electronic Soul Network Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Electronic Soul Network Technology Co., Ltd., researches, develops and publishes online and mobile games in China and internationally. It offers H5 games, VR games, consoles, stand-alone games, and apps platforms, as well as comics and e-sports events, and other fields. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Hangzhou, China.
